verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own export paths for the core data. The Raw Event Export API returns all events with every property as JSONL and is recommended for high-volume exports. The Engage API exports user profiles, and the UI can export events as CSV. A community comment independently calls the export policy great. missing for 10: evidence that saved reports, dashboards, cohorts and session replays can be exported, and a documented offboarding or account-exit process.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: To export raw event data, use the Raw Event Export API. The events payload is returned as JSONL
The raw export API allows you to download your event data as it is received and stored within Mixpanel, complete with all event properties
To export User Profile data, use the Engage API.
You can export data from your project using a variety of methods, including lightweight CSVs generated from the UI, large volume raw data export from our APIs
